mapper.select: select config_key as configKey, schedule_enabled as scheduleEnabled, cron_expression as cron, semester, date_format(semester_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as semesterStartDate, date_format(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updatedAt from timetable_integration_config where config_key = #{configKey}
mapper.insert: insert into timetable_integration_config ( config_key, schedule_enabled, cron_expression, semester, semester_start_date, updated_at ) values ( #{configKey}, #{scheduleEnabled}, #{cronExpression}, #{semester}, #{semesterStartDate}, now() ) on duplicate key update schedule_enabled = values(schedule_enabled), cron_expression = values(cron_expression), semester = values(semester), semester_start_date = values(semester_start_date), updated_at = now()
mapper.select: select id, trigger_type as triggerType, status, scope, source, success_account as successAccount, attempts, updated_count as updatedCount, date_format(started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as startedAt, date_format(finished_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as finishedAt, error_message as error, output, log_path as logPath from timetable_import_job order by started_at desc, id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update timetable_import_job set status = #{status}, success_account = #{successAccount}, attempts = #{attempts}, updated_count = #{updatedCount}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, error_message = #{error}, output = #{output}, log_path = #{logPath} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select config_key as credentialKey, credential_username_cipher as usernameCipher, credential_password_cipher as passwordCipher, date_format(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updatedAt from timetable_integration_config where config_key = #{credentialKey} and credential_username_cipher is not null and credential_password_cipher is not null
mapper.insert: insert into timetable_integration_config ( config_key, schedule_enabled, cron_expression, credential_username_cipher, credential_password_cipher, updated_at ) values ( #{credentialKey}, 0, '0 0 2 * * *', #{usernameCipher}, #{passwordCipher}, now() ) on duplicate key update credential_username_cipher = values(credential_username_cipher), credential_password_cipher = values(credential_password_cipher), updated_at = now()
mapper.update: update timetable_integration_config set credential_username_cipher = null, credential_password_cipher = null, updated_at = now() where config_key = #{credentialKey}
